title: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya
text:
Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

['From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

Hi team,

Quick heads up: I need to request an interim manager assignment for Aditya Rao effective next week while I’m on medical leave (scheduled 10/06–10/20). This is a sensitive personnel matter — performance discussion and a short coaching plan are attached.

Proposal (high level):
- Interim manager: Laura Bennett (10/06 start)
- 30-day check-in cadence with Marcus as backup for escalations
- Aditya to remain on current project scope; Laura will take ownership of one-on-ones and performance follow-ups

Immediate asks:
1) Laura — can you confirm availability to start interim coverage on 10/06?
2) Monica/Marcus — any compliance/hr flags I should surface before we notify Aditya?
3) People Ops: looping Kate (external consultant) for neutrality on the communications and to help with the transition template.

I’ve attached: handoff_checklist_v2.xlsx, short_term_org_chart.pdf, aditya_performance_summary.docx (confidential). Please treat this thread as limited distribution.

Thanks — Neha

Neha Kapoor
Head of Product Platforms
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124
', "From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

Neha — thanks for the note and for the clear checklist. I can take interim manager duties starting 10/06. A few quick clarifications:
- Do we want to run the first 1:1 as a private coaching starter (I will handle tone and will not escalate unless needed).
- For pay/comp or role-change language — I assume none of that changes today; this is strictly coverage.

I'll review the performance summary offline and will prepare a brief agenda for the initial 1:1.

Laura

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Solutions
laura_bennett@redwood.com
", "From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:26:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

Thanks — tagging on compliance: Monica, I reviewed the summary and don't see active disciplinary steps or PIP paperwork in Workday. Monica, can you confirm there are no open investigations or formal HR actions? If there are, please flag immediately so we can pause any manager messaging.

Also: Suggest we keep the initial message to Aditya focused on support and coverage (no mention of performance documentation). Once Laura confirms tone, we can sync with People Ops on the script.

Marcus

Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering
marcus_lin@redwood.com
", 'From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:07:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

Marcus/Neha/Laura — confirmed: no open investigations or formal HR actions on Aditya in Workday. I reviewed past notes; there have been informal coaching conversations (documented), but nothing escalated to a formal PIP. Recommend People Ops join the first 1:1 as an observer for the initial transitional conversation to ensure we use neutral phrasing.

Monica

Monica Patel
People Ops Manager
monica_patel@redwood.com
', 'From: Kate Morris <kate@hrconsult.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Manager handoff & confidential notice — interim assignment for Aditya

Neha and team — thanks for including me. Quick notes from the consultant side:
- Use this script at first 1:1 (confidential): "Hi Aditya — I’ll be covering your one-on-ones while Neha is on leave. My goal is to support you and make sure you have clear priorities. If anything feels off, we’ll connect privately with People Ops."
- Do not share the performance_summary.docx in the initial message. Keep attachments internal.
- Suggested 1:1 agenda (30 min): 5m personal check-in, 10m priorities/roadblocks, 10m support plan, 5m next steps.

I can join the 10/06 10:00AM PT meeting as an observer. If you want me to draft the short script and calendar invite language, say the word and I’ll send a tight template (will also provide a one-paragraph note for the employee file).

Best,
Kate Morris
People Ops Consultant
HRConsult Co.
kate@hrconsult.co
', 'On Mon, Oct 4, 2026 at 15:10 Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks all — Laura confirmed availability. Monica confirmed no active HR actions. Kate, please draft the one-paragraph script and send it to this thread. I will schedule the first 10/06 10:00AM PT 1:1 and keep the invite private.
>
> —Neha
']
